motivation.observation: The existing graph semantic seed concatenates tool-domain, operation-action, endpoint-description, and returned-field terms into one embedding surface.
motivation.risk: A single mixed representation can trade tool-domain separation against operation/field similarity and can produce cross-tool errors.
source_level_support: LlamaIndex separates candidate retrieval from selector execution.
vLLM Semantic Router keeps signal families distinct and projects them later.
LangGraph routes only to predeclared destinations.
Aurelio supports eligibility filtering before final thresholded routing.

architecture: Embed one option per authorized tool using tool name and tool description only.
Require the configured direct similarity/margin boundary before committing to a tool.
Construct the second-stage option set only from registered endpoints of the selected tool.
Resolve operation using operation name, trusted aliases, and endpoint description only.
If stage two abstains, obey the existing fail-closed/fallback policy.
Never create a tool, endpoint, field, argument, or execution authority from semantic output.

evaluation.corpus: the exact fresh v4 development corpus produced by PR #184 artifact
required_diagnostics: paired gains/losses versus baseline and historical graph

selection_policy: Do not modify this architecture from v4 baseline or historical-graph results before its first execution. Development results may determine whether this ablation is rejected or whether a separately preregistered threshold study is warranted.
